newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on market operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on market operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended up on Wednesday as the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) picked up two billion rupees in an open market operation, dealers said.
In anticipation of the operation, the overnight market opened with offers around 15 percent but bids were in the range of eight to nine percent, one dealer said.
He said initial overnight deals were struck at 12 percent but soon the rates went up to 15 percent as the central bank entered the market.

The SBP picked up two billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 15.70 percent in the operation, the dealer said. The banks also also received bids worth 4.8 billion rupees for six-month short-term federal bonds in a separate auction, whose result was to be announced later.
Dealers said the auction result would set Thursday's market direction.
